sources.title: Qwen3.5-4B LoRA Fine-tuning on Step-3.5-Flash-SFT - GitHub
sources.snippet: This experiment validates whether a single H100 can efficiently fine-tune Qwen3.5-4B on general agent/coding/reasoning data that the base model has never seen before, using a large LoRA rank to compensate for the domain gap.

sources.title: Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B | vLLM Recipes
sources.snippet: Qwen3.5-4B is the compact dense entry in the Qwen3.5 family — same gated delta networks architecture, vision encoder, 262K context, and MTP decoding as the larger siblings, sized for 16 GB consumer GPUs.
